$stride = $data.Stride

# BG mask: 1 = connected to border and near-white
$bg = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[int]'
$stack = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.Stack[int]

function NearWhite($bytes, $stride, $x, $y) {
  $i = $y * $stride + $x * 4
  return ($bytes[$i] -ge 232 -and $bytes[$i+1] -ge 232 -and $bytes[$i+2] -ge 232)
}

for ($x = 0; $x -lt $bw; $x++) {
  foreach ($y in @(0, $bh - 1)) {
    if (NearWhite $bytes $stride $x $y) { $k = $y * $bw + $x; if ($bg.Add($k)) { $stack.Push($k) } }
  }
}
for ($y = 0; $y -lt $bh; $y++) {
  foreach ($x in @(0, $bw - 1)) {
    if (NearWhite $bytes $stride $x $y) { $k = $y * $bw + $x; if ($bg.Add($k)) { $stack.Push($k) } }
  }
}

while ($stack.Count -gt 0) {
  $k = $stack.Pop()
  $x = $k % $bw; $y = [Math]::Floor($k / $bw)
  if ($x -gt 0     -and (NearWhite $bytes $stride ($x-1) $y)) { $n = $y*$bw+($x-1); if ($bg.Add($n)) { $stack.Push($n) } }

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import os

SRC = r"C:\Users\JHOSEP\OneDrive\Desktop\Polleria_SaukoChiken\assets\images\icono-logo.jpeg"
OUT = r"C:\Users\JHOSEP\OneDrive\Desktop\Polleria_SaukoChiken\assets\images"

img = Image.open(SRC).convert("RGB")
W, H = img.size
px = img.load()


def is_whiteish(p, t=238):
    r, g, b = p
    return r >= t and g >= t and b >= t


def is_wood(p):
    r, g, b = p
    return r >= 105 and g >= 78 and b <= 155 and (r - b) >= 50 and (g - b) >= 15


def is_dark(p, t=130):
    return max(p) < t


# ---------------- máscara de madera ----------------
wood = Image.new("L", (W, H), 0)
wp = wood.load()
for y in range(H):
    for x in range(W):

wd = wood_dil.load()

minx, miny, maxx, maxy = W, H, -1, -1

    if recolor_tagline:

        for y in range(BAND_TOP, BAND_BOT):

            if ly < 0 or ly >= ch:

                p = cpx[x, ly]
                if is_dark(p) and wd[gx, y] < 128:

    w, h = crop.size
    work = crop.copy()
    marker = (255, 0, 255)
    step = max(1, min(w, h) // 240)
    for x in range(0, w, step):
        for y in (0, h - 1):
            r, g, b = work.getpixel((x, y))
            if (r, g, b) != marker and r >= 200 and g >= 200 and b >= 200:
                ImageDraw.floodfill(work, (x, y), marker, thresh=thresh)
    for y in range(0, h, step):
        for x in (0, w - 1):
            r, g, b = work.getpixel((x, y))
            if (r, g, b) != marker and r >= 200 and g >= 200 and b >= 200:
                ImageDraw.floodfill(work, (x, y), marker, thresh=thresh)

    out = bytearray(w * h * 4)
    for i, (r, g, b) in enumerate(work.getdata()):
        o = i * 4
        if (r, g, b) == marker:

        lum = min(r, g, b)

            out[o:o + 4] = bytes((r, g, b, a))
        else:
            out[o:o + 4] = bytes((r, g, b, 255))
    rgba = Image.frombytes("RGBA", (w, h), bytes(out))
    bb = rgba.getbbox()
    return rgba.crop(bb) if bb else rgba
